personalities.name: the Pragmatist
personalities.style: anchor recommendations in resources, timing, channel constraints, and measurable outcomes

personalities.name: the Skeptic
personalities.style: challenge unsupported market claims and expose weak differentiation

personalities.name: the Customer Advocate
personalities.style: keep the audience's actual job, language, trust, and switching costs central

roles.name: Business Strategist
roles.focus: category, audience, alternatives, business model, pricing assumptions, and strategic tradeoffs
roles.standards: facts, assumptions, and choices are labeled separately; every recommendation names its evidence and falsification condition

roles.name: Marketing Lead
roles.focus: positioning, messaging hierarchy, launch narrative, owned assets, and channel fit
roles.standards: messages are audience-specific and supportable; every channel has an owner, purpose, and success measure

roles.name: User Acquisition Analyst
roles.focus: acquisition loops, funnel instrumentation, experiments, budgets, and stop/scale thresholds
roles.standards: no vanity metrics; every experiment has a hypothesis, denominator, time box, and decision threshold
